name: DigiFest
author: digitalinnovationglobal

sections.description:
DigiFest decorates your online store or WordPress site with lightweight animated seasonal effects and announcement banners to delight your visitors and boost seasonal conversions.

🌟 DigiFest Free Features (Included)

  • Halloween Theme: Flying bats, bouncing pumpkins, floating ghosts, and optional jumpscare zoom effect.
  • Christmas Theme: Falling snowflakes, Santa Claus crossing the screen, holiday gift boxes, snowballs, and optional traditional Catalan festive icons (Caga Tió, Caganer, and Star of Bethlehem).
  • Manual or Scheduled Activation: Trigger effects manually or schedule them by recurring calendar dates (MM-DD) so your website decorates itself year after year automatically.
  • Configurable Density: Low, medium, or high particle count to fit any website layout.
  • Location Targeting: Display effects across the entire site, homepage only, or WooCommerce shop pages only.
  • WooCommerce Announcement Banner: Dismissible seasonal bar with coupon code notice and customizable background and font colors.
  • Ambient Atmosphere Layer: Screen corners and garland decorations (cobwebs, festive lights, garlands).
  • Click Sparkles Effect: Subtle thematic micro-particles bursting upon user clicks.
  • Accessibility & Performance: 60 FPS GPU-accelerated CSS animations with strict respect for prefers-reduced-motion and mobile responsiveness toggle.

🚀 Upgrade to DigiFest Pro — Decorate All Year Round

Take your store’s seasonal marketing to the next level with DigiFest Pro. Unlock the complete 365-day holiday calendar, advanced 3D visual effects, custom ambient soundtracks, and premium seasonal themes:

  • 💘 Valentine’s Day (Feb 14): Floating hearts, Cupid with golden arrows, love letters, and romantic garland.
  • 🍾 New Year’s Eve (Dec 31): Multicolored confetti showers, sparkling fireworks, champagne flutes, and countdown clock.
  • 🐰 Easter & Spring: Decorated Easter eggs, hopping bunnies, blooming daisies, and fluttering butterflies.
  • 🍀 St. Patrick’s Day (Mar 17): Four-leaf clovers, pots of gold, leprechaun hats, and rainbow trails.
  • 🌸 Spring & Sakura: Floating cherry blossom petals, wildflower wreaths, fluttering honeybees, and branch overlay.
  • ☀️ Summer Beach: Radiant smiling suns, palm leaves, tropical ice cream cones, seagulls, and animated footer ocean waves.
  • 🍂 Autumn & Castanyada: Falling golden maple leaves, roasted chestnuts, acorns, and harvest pumpkins.
  • 🏷️ Black Friday & Cyber Week: Floating discount badges, neon sale ribbons, mystery gift boxes, and countdown bars.
  • 🎭 Venice Carnival: Venetian masks, festive streamers, maracas, and vibrant confetti.
  • 🦃 Thanksgiving Day: Festive turkeys, pumpkins, abundance cornucopia, and elegant “Give Thanks” header plaque.
  • 🤠 Texas Day & Western Rodeo: Cowboy hats, leather boots, golden horseshoes, and desert saguaro cacti.
  • 🎆 4th of July (Independence Day): Red, white & blue fireworks with animated fighter jet formation flyover.
  • 🎅 Christmas Plus Edition: Flying Santa sleigh gliding across the page header, Wise Kings, and 3D festive greeting surprise.
  • 🎃 Halloween Plus Edition: Enhanced 3D jumpscare with configurable sound intensity, realistic cobweb corners, and floating phantoms.

🌐 Digital Innovation Global Ecosystem

DigiFest is part of the official suite of WordPress productivity & growth tools by Digital Innovation Global:
* WooToolkit Pro: 1-step checkout, persistent carts & AOV sales boost for WooCommerce.
* WP GEO Optimizer: Local GEO SEO acceleration and smart CDN asset distribution.
* Digital Translate WP Pro: AI neural translations to 100+ languages preserving layout and SEO.
* Booster WP Pro: Local SEO content generation and city satellite page builder.
* FloatClient Pro: Smart floating AI customer support widget & WhatsApp lead generator.

Learn more in the plugin settings under the 🚀 Más Plugins tab.

External services

DigiFest optionally connects to the Digital Innovation Global licensing API to validate voluntary Pro license keys and verify license status.

  • Service Provider: Digital Innovation Global LLC
  • Service URL: https://licencias.digitalinnovationglobal.com/api/v1/
  • What data is sent: When a user voluntarily submits a license key or purchase code, the plugin sends the license key, current site URL, and plugin slug. No personal or visitor data is tracked or collected.
  • When data is sent: Only upon voluntary submission of a license key in the admin panel, or during scheduled daily checks if a license key is actively stored. If no license key is entered, no external requests are made.
  • Terms of Service: https://festivo.digitalinnovationglobal.com/terminos-condiciones.html
  • Privacy Policy: https://festivo.digitalinnovationglobal.com/politica-privacidad.html
sections.installation:
1. Upload the digifest.zip file via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin, or search for DigiFest directly in the WordPress plugin directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to DigiFest in the admin sidebar to enable and configure your seasonal themes.
sections.faq:
Can I activate an effect outside of its holiday dates?

Yes. Simply check “Activate now (manual)” on any theme to enable it immediately regardless of the calendar date.

Do the scheduled dates repeat every year?

Yes. Scheduled dates are saved in MM-DD format and automatically re-engage every year during that timeframe.

What is the difference between DigiFest Free and DigiFest Pro?

The free version includes complete Halloween and Christmas animations. DigiFest Pro unlocks the full 365-day festive calendar with 12+ additional international holidays, regional packs (Thanksgiving, Texas Rodeo, 4th of July flyovers, World Cities), 3D interactive surprises (flying Santa sleigh, jumpscare plus with sound), ambient layers, and lifetime priority support.

Can I upgrade to DigiFest Pro without losing my existing settings?

Yes! When upgrading to DigiFest Pro, all your existing date schedules, banner texts, colors, and layout preferences are automatically preserved.

What happens if multiple themes are active simultaneously?

DigiFest displays the first active theme from the priority list to keep your page clean, beautiful, and lightweight.

Are the animations accessible and mobile-friendly?

Yes. DigiFest respects your visitors’ system preferences and disables motion automatically when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled. You can also toggle mobile display on or off with a single click.
sections.changelog:
1.2.3

  • Added official “🚀 Más Plugins” cross-promotion tab showcasing the Digital Innovation Global plugin ecosystem (WooToolkit Pro, WP GEO Optimizer, Digital Translate WP Pro, Festivo Pro, Booster WP Pro, FloatClient Pro).
  • Added comprehensive DigiFest Free vs PRO features documentation and roadmap.
  • Enhanced admin header navigation with direct Pro feature showcase and live interactive simulator access.
  • Added modern card styles and subtle cross-promotional footer bar.
  • Verified compatibility with WordPress 7.1 and WooCommerce 9.0+.

1.2.2

  • Fixed admin panel styling: enabled responsive text wrapping for long translations and improved banner color picker layout.

1.2.1

  • Removed UTF-8 BOM encoding across all PHP files to resolve unexpected output headers.
  • Updated text domain to match plugin slug ‘digifest’ and refactored function/class prefixes.

1.2.0

  • Complete compatibility with WordPress 7.1.
  • Streamlined codebase and enqueued inline scripts via WordPress standard APIs.
  • Refactored localization and updated documentation for WordPress.org directory compliance.

1.1.0

  • Added ambient decoration layers and interactive click sparkles.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: Animated seasonal themes, WooCommerce announcement banner, and date scheduler.
